**Analysis:**

**Comparison:**
- **Downy_mildew**: Description says "white parallel stripes of varying width alternating with green tissue" on young plants — matches well, but reference images show mostly uniformly pale/light plants
- **Maize_dwarf_mosaic_virus**: Reference shows wide alternating pale and green bands similar to test image, but description says "narrow" streaks
- **Maize_streak_virus**: Reference shows finer, more numerous narrow streaks — doesn't match the wide stripes seen here

The test image most closely matches **Downy_mildew**: wide parallel white-yellow stripes of varying width alternating with green tissue on young corn plants, consistent with infection at the whorl stage. The MDMV reference (bottom-right panel) also showed similar wide pale bands, but the plants in the test image show very broad, clear alternating stripes — more typical of downy mildew.
